lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are arranged in distinct vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank, forming a structured grid-like array with roughly equidistant spacing between individual blobs.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, particularly evident in the mid-section posterior to the pectoral fin, creating well-defined anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs bounded within its silhouette, with higher concentrations located along the anterior margin and the lower half of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of small, stochastic high-luminance spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the head and the anterior margin of the pectoral fin, distinct from the larger grid-patterned blobs on the flank.
